title: Audio-centric Video Understanding Benchmark without Text Shortcut

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating if models can correctly answer multimodal questions using text-only inputs by testing 'Cycled Accuracy' across permutations, identifying questions where formulation biases give away the answer.
Creating four cyclic permutations of multiple-choice answer options (ABCD, BCDA, CDAB, DABC) to test model consistency and exclude the influence of inherent positional preferences in LLMs.

Conducting qualitative analysis and multi-stage human review of annotated question-answer pairs to identify and correct human tendency to rely on visually-grounded cues rather than the intended audio information.
